THING_MODEL.SPECIFICATIONS:
LCD
Text display component.

Features:
  • Can display two lines of text, fourteen characters per line.
  • Can be set to use analog or custom read.
Usage:
  • Connect to MCU or SBC.
  • Display text when input is detected from either pin.
Direct Control:
  • N/A
Local Control:
  • Connect to digital or analog slot.
Remote Control:
  • N/A
Data Specifications:
Input Slot: D0 for customRead
Input Slot: A0 for analogRead

Example:
Connect to an MCU and potentiometer and see the text change in the LCD as the potentiometer is turned.
